COMMIT 2 (`015f81c1`): landed `isImpShaped`/`intSubfmls_impCount_le` (number of `.imp`-node POSITIONS, not distinct values, in `intSubfmls phi` is <= `phi.complexity`) as verified, sorry-free, axiom-clean supporting infrastructure for the world bound. THE FULL `intExpandBranches_world_bound` LEMMA REMAINS OPEN. Extensive investigation (superseding the prior dispatch's vaguer note) determined the EXACT correct mechanism: (1) the naive 'one world per occurrence, simple depth argument' is WRONG because F-or (`.neg,.or`) is `.linearResult`/ALPHA (Rules.lean:260), so a single world can accumulate MULTIPLE independent F-imp obligations (e.g. from `(a->b) or (c->d)`), each independently capable of creating a SIBLING world -- so the bound needs a width-AND-depth argument, not depth alone; (2) verified against Rules.lean that `posFormulasAt`/`propagatePersistence`/`intTImpRule` are ALL `.pos`-only (lines 126, 139-141, 174-186) -- F-signed formulas NEVER propagate across worlds via persistence, so each world's F-formulas are exactly the decomposition closure of ONE 'obligation' formula (phi0 at world 0; the consequent psi placed by whichever F(phi->psi) rule created any other world); (3) since decomposition never duplicates a tree position into two lineage branches within one completed branch (BETA picks one child per split; ALPHA keeps both but at the SAME world), the map (world created) -> (the specific .imp tree-POSITION of phi0 whose firing created it) is INJECTIVE into phi0's .imp-node positions, giving (worlds created) <= phi.complexity via `intSubfmls_impCount_le`, hence eraseDups.length <= phi.complexity + 1 (the +1 for world 0) -- exactly the target bound. Formalizing this injection requires a NEW ghost/positional-tracking invariant threaded through a top-level induction mirroring `Soundness.lean`'s `intExpandBranches_closed_unsat` (~700 lines, Soundness.lean:1039-1714) -- i.e. a full induction over intExpandBranches's go recursion (outer on fuel, inner on pending), NOT a mirror of any existing Modal-K lemma (Modal-K's own modalWorldBound is EXPONENTIAL and never needed this argument -- this is genuinely new mathematics for the intuitionistic calculus). Estimated ~500-800 lines given the intExpandBranches_closed_unsat scale comparison, exceeding the ~400-line H8 split threshold for a single dispatch; a full, honest attempt was made (see reasoning trail) before recording this continuation, per the user directive to exhaust the occurrence-tracking approach first.
